title: Displacement at t=1s
description: Essential: Correctly calculates B's displacement in the first second as 1 m using kinematics for constant acceleration from rest.

title: Time of maximum distance
description: Essential: Correctly identifies the time when the distance between A and B is greatest as 4.5 s, based on comparing velocities.

title: Maximum distance value
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the maximum distance between the particles as 18.61 m, using displacements of A and B up to the critical time.

title: Total catch-up time
description: Essential: Correctly determines the total time for B to catch A as 10.6 s, accounting for the periodic acceleration pattern and initial separation.

title: B's displacement pattern
description: Important: Recognizes that B's displacement in each second forms an arithmetic series (1m, 2m, 3m,...) due to the given acceleration profile.

title: Velocity comparison step
description: Important: Applies the condition that maximum separation occurs when B's instantaneous velocity equals A's constant velocity (5 m/s).

title: Post-10s kinematics

title: Unit consistency

title: Sign error in separation
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly formulates the separation distance as x_B - x_A - Δx instead of Δx + x_A - x_B, leading to a sign mistake.

title: Arithmetic series misapplication
description: Pitfall: Misapplies the formula for the sum of an arithmetic series (e.g., using n(n-1)/2 instead of n(n+1)/2) for B's total displacement.
